---
title: "Notebooks"
---

Hands-on **PyTorch** notebooks — each grows out of a lecture. Every one is sized in *hours, not days*; most run on a free Colab GPU and several need no GPU at all. Download to run locally, or open in Colab. These are also the seeds of the [homeworks](labs/index.qmd) — each assignment takes one you've already run and pushes it further.

## Primer · Probability & MLE

| Notebook | Lecture | What you do |
|---|:---:|---|
| [iid-demo](notebooks/lec00-iid-demo.ipynb) | L00 | IID vs non-IID — sequences, histograms, lag-1 scatter; why `sum(log p)` is blind to autocorrelation |
| [bernoulli-playground](notebooks/lec00-bernoulli-playground.ipynb) | L00 | The three operations on a Bernoulli — sample, PMF, log-prob — and MLE by hand |
| [mle-map](notebooks/lec00-mle-map.ipynb) | L00B | MLE → MAP in PyTorch: ridge and lasso emerge from Gaussian / Laplace priors |

## Spine · Foundations → Transformers

| Notebook | Lecture | What you do |
|---|:---:|---|
| [micrograd-mlp](notebooks/01-micrograd-mlp.ipynb) | L01 · L03 | Build the micrograd autodiff engine and train an MLP with it |

| [debug-ladder](notebooks/03-debug-ladder.ipynb) | L03 | Work the training debug ladder against planted bugs |
| [optimizers](notebooks/05-optimizers.ipynb) | L04 · L05 | Race SGD vs momentum vs Adam and read the curves |
| [cnn-shape-tour](notebooks/07-cnn-shape-tour.ipynb) | L07 | CNN tensor shapes and receptive fields, by hand |
| [rnn-by-hand](notebooks/10-rnn-by-hand.ipynb) | L10 | An RNN cell from scratch, unrolled over a sequence |
| [attention-by-hand](notebooks/12-attention-by-hand.ipynb) | L12 | Attention from raw matmuls — then verify it |
| [nanogpt](notebooks/13-nanogpt.ipynb) | L13 · L14 | Train a tiny GPT on Tiny Shakespeare |
